questions.question: What is the value of the sum Σ_{n=0}^∞ (1/2)^n?
questions.topic: Power Series for EE - Sum of Geometric Series
questions.tutor: Geometric series: Σ r^n = 1/(1-r) for |r|<1. Here r=1/2 → sum = 1/(1-0.5)=2.

questions.question: What is the power series of 1/(1 - x)^2 for |x|<1?
questions.topic: Power Series for EE - Differentiating Series
questions.tutor: 1/(1-x) = Σ x^n. Differentiate: d/dx [1/(1-x)] = 1/(1-x)² = Σ n x^{n-1} = Σ (n+1) x^n.

questions.question: What is the radius of convergence of Σ_{n=0}^∞ (x-3)^n / 2^n?
questions.topic: Power Series for EE - Radius from Center
questions.tutor: Geometric series in (x-3)/2 → converges when |(x-3)/2|<1 → |x-3|<2 → R=2.

questions.question: What is the first non-zero term in the Maclaurin series of sin(x²)?
questions.topic: Power Series for EE - Composition of Series
questions.tutor: sin u = u - u³/6 + ... with u=x² → sin(x²)= x² - x⁶/6 + ... → first term x².
